title: Geospatial proxy indicators for air-pollution exposure assessment: screened corpus, coding, evidence map and analysis code

creators.name: Handsome Bongani Nyoni
creators.affiliation: Midlands State University; University of Cape Town

creators.name: Prestige Tatenda Makanga
creators.affiliation: Midlands State University; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; CeSHHAR Zimbabwe

description: Screened corpus, study-level coding, derived tables, co-occurrence networks and analysis code for a bibliometric and validation evidence map of geospatial proxy indicators used in air-pollution exposure assessment. 2217 unique records were screened and 692 included. Fields owned by Scopus and Web of Science are withheld and listed in WITHHELD_FIELDS.md.
